verdict.rationale: The firm publishes an O-1 entrepreneur walkthrough showing how a founder can both operate and direct their own business on an O-1. That glancingly touches founder control arrangements, but it does not explicitly explain the startup acting as the petitioner. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a founder-owned startup petitioning for its founder, beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements (the employer-employee relationship), coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance

citations.quote: we can craft a job description that lets you cook but also direct the course of the business. This is allowed on the O-1.
